historical_growth.growth_rate_source: order-book path: FY2026 12% on H1 2026 +16.6% revenue and book-to-bill 1.36, fading to 2.5% by year 9; 5.0% is the 10-year average of the base path
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR is negative (3yr -0.1%, 5yr -3.8%) and 5yr revenue CAGR is -1.6% because FY2021-22 carried RMB13.6bn of net losses on legacy thermal impairments; the equity series is not a usable growth anchor. EPS 3yr CAGR is undefined (FY2022 EPS -0.228). Owner-FCF 3yr CAGR +7.8% (FY2022 3,933 -> FY2025 4,930 on the SBC-zero, interest-stripped series) and FY2020 owner FCF was negative (-2,163), so the 5yr figure is undefined. Revenue has recovered from the FY2023 trough of 114.8bn to 126.7bn with H1 2026 +16.6%.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF series (reported FCF less interest income; SBC nil): FY2018 2,228; FY2019 3,424; FY2020 -2,163; FY2021 -15,180; FY2022 3,933; FY2023 2,926; FY2024 12,230; FY2025 4,930. The FY2024 figure is a working-capital spike (contract liabilities +13.8bn); the 8-year average is ~1.5bn, which is the honest run-rate before the float.

scenario_narratives.base: Order wave converts to 12%/8%/6% revenue growth then fades to 2.5%; adjusted EBITDA margin 5.3% -> 6.0% as thermal legacy exits; cash tax 45% -> 30% as unrecognised losses are absorbed; prepayment float captures 15% of revenue growth; 12x terminal cap binds.
scenario_narratives.bull: H1 2026 run-rate holds, nuclear/offshore wind/storage/overseas EPC extend double-digit growth to 2028; margin 7% and 25% statutory cash tax by Y7; float captures 20%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Thermal orders peak, revenue shrinks FY2029-30, margin 4.2-4.6%, cash tax stays >50%, float unwinds; consolidated FCF near zero and the equity is mostly the investments and net cash less minorities.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Shanghai Electric is valued as a consolidated owner-FCF stream from a thin-margin, float-funded capital-goods business, with the associates and investment portfolio added at book, minorities deducted once at book, and net cash (inclusive of the finance company's bank placements, net of restricted deposits and affiliate deposits) added. The consolidated business generates little free cash before working capital at today's 5% margin and 50%+ cash tax rate, so the valuation is a bet on margin and tax normalisation as the thermal legacy exits, not on growth; the order book supports the near-term revenue path but not a re-rating. Risk is carried in the flows and the 30% bear weight, not in the discount rate, and the terminal multiple is capped at 12x for a chronically low-multiple H share.
key_risks_to_valuation: NCI at book (RMB25.1bn) is the single largest bridge item; if the elevator JV and other high-NCI subsidiaries are worth materially more than book, attributable value is lower than modelled, and vice versa for loss-making NCI subsidiaries
Cash tax rate on EBIT is 50-60% today because of RMB2.1bn/yr of unrelieved subsidiary losses; the base assumes it glides to 30% and that glide is worth most of the gap between the bear and base cases
Impairment charges (RMB2-3bn/yr) are treated as a recurring operating cost; a return to FY2021-scale write-downs (RMB10bn+) would sit below the bear case
Working-capital float: contract liabilities of RMB72bn (54% of revenue) fund the business; an order downturn unwinds it, and the bear's -5% capture may understate how fast
Net cash counts RMB18.4bn of finance-company bank placements and treats RMB6.1bn of affiliate deposits as debt; RMB6.6bn of affiliate loans and RMB24bn of other current assets are not credited
A/H discount of ~65% and SOE governance: no catalyst compels the gap to close, and capital allocation follows national strategy
fx_rate 1.1751 is frozen at the valuation date; a price refresh does not move it

inputs.share_count_basis: 15,540,121,636 shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (interim report, Share Capital Structure: 12,615.6m A shares + 2,924.5m H shares). Diluted EPS equals basic EPS in FY2025 and H1 2026, so there are no dilutive instruments; the FY2025 A-share buyback (RMB300m, 39.7m shares) was cancelled, taking the count from 15,579.8m to 15,540.1m. Held FLAT: no SBC charge in the flows and no non-SBC issuance.
inputs.net_debt_note: 30 June 2026 consolidated balance sheet (RMB m). total_debt = short-term borrowings 12,175 + non-current liabilities maturing within one year 5,576 + long-term borrowings 19,510 + bonds payable 6,994 (= 44,255, the Metrics.csv TotalDebt) + deposits from customers, banks and other financial institutions 6,118 (the group finance company's deposit funding, which the company itself counts as debt in its 40.18% gearing ratio). Non-current lease liabilities 1,792 EXCLUDED because leases are charged in the flows (treatment B); the ~0.4bn current lease portion inside the 5,576 is left in, which is slightly conservative. cash = cash at bank and on hand 43,577 less restricted cash 5,199 (FY2025 note 5(1) figure, used as the proxy since the condensed interim does not restate it) plus placements with banks and other financial institutions 18,433, which the FY2025 cash-equivalents note (5(75)(d)) itself treats as cash equivalents. Not credited: loans and advances to customers 6,583 (finance company lending to affiliates), financial assets purchased under resale agreements 1,626, other current assets 24,042 (input VAT etc.), deferred tax assets 8,169. The company's own gearing-ratio arithmetic implies ~RMB1.9bn more interest-bearing liabilities than the balance-sheet lines above (super short-term financing bills inside other current liabilities); that is within the margin left by the uncredited assets and is not separately deducted.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report note 5(75)(a), reconciliation of net profit to operating cash flow: no share-based payment add-back in FY2025 or FY2024 (the FY2020-22 restricted-share plan charge of RMB150-185m has run off; FY2023 shows a reversal). SBC held at 0% of revenue as an explicit row (SBC-zero market). interest_income 574 is the treasury interest income inside 'Financial expenses' (income statement, FY2025); it is stripped because the group is net cash. The finance company's RMB717m interest income on loans to affiliates sits inside total revenue and is NOT stripped, because its matching asset (loans and advances) is likewise not credited in the bridge.
inputs.reported_fcf_note: FY2025 net cash from operating activities 10,516 less cash paid for fixed assets, intangibles and other long-term assets 5,012. Under CAS the operating cash flow is PRE-interest (interest paid sits in financing: 'cash payments for distribution of dividends, profits or interest expenses' 2,955), so reported_fcf is an unlevered figure and consistent with an EV-based discount. It also includes RMB3.5bn of working-capital inflow from contract-liability and payable growth and excludes RMB1.58bn of dividends received from associates (investing).
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025: RMB300m A-share repurchase by the Company (cancelled) plus RMB125m by subsidiaries; FY2024 nil. Final dividend RMB0.01425/share (RMB221m) for FY2025; no FY2026 interim dividend. The flat count is funded, modestly, by cancellation buybacks.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1751 (Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-22, same fetch as the price). Statements and all flows are RMB; the H-share quote is HKD, so every RMB per-share value is multiplied by 1.1751. No HKD dual listing exists for a parity check: the A-share 601727.SS trades at CNY 6.13 (Yahoo, same fetch), i.e. the H share stands at a ~65% discount to the A share, which is the long-standing A/H premium on this name and not an FX error. Direction check: HKD price / 1.1751 x 15,540m shares = ~RMB33bn market capitalisation, 0.6x attributable book of RMB55.3bn and ~27x FY2025 EPS of RMB0.078, consistent with the stock's screened profile. refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate; re-source it on each price refresh.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-22T03:57:47Z (Yahoo chart API, intraday HK session; 52-week range 2.505-5.33, the print is AT the 52-week low)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows. Risk-free: China 10y CGB ~1.8%. ERP 6.5%. Beta 1.2 for a levered, thin-margin, order-cyclical capital-goods SOE gives a cost of equity of ~9.6%. Pre-tax cost of debt 2.8% (FY2025 interest expense RMB1,289m on ~RMB46bn average borrowings and bonds), 2.1% after 25% tax. Target capital weights 60/40 equity/debt (market cap ~RMB33bn against ~RMB50bn gross interest-bearing liabilities; market weights would push the WACC toward 5% on the strength of SOE borrowing costs, which is not a rate an H-share minority can borrow at). WACC = 0.6 x 9.6 + 0.4 x 2.1 = 6.6%, used as 7.0%. The SAME 7.0% applies to all three scenarios: cyclicality, the legacy-thermal drag, governance and the H-share discount are carried in the scenario flows and the 30% bear weight, not stacked in a per-scenario WACC. Terminal growth 2.0% base (below Chinese nominal GDP; coal-fired equipment is in structural decline), cap 12x terminal FCF for a cyclical that has never commanded a high multiple.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: full lease payment (FY2025 repayments of lease liabilities RMB695m, note 5(74), plus ~RMB90m of lease interest estimated at ~4% on RMB2.2bn of lease liabilities, the filing does not split lease interest out) = ~RMB785m, 0.6% of revenue, deducted inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path; non-current lease liabilities (RMB1,792m at 30 June 2026) EXCLUDED from net debt. da_pct_path is D&A ex right-of-use depreciation: FY2025 total D&A 3,536 (fixed assets 2,045 + ROU 544 + intangibles 561 + investment property 95 + long-term prepaid 291) less ROU 544 = 2,992, 2.36% of revenue.
inputs.nci_treatment: Minority interests are large and take most of the consolidated profit: RMB1,879m of RMB3,086m net profit in FY2025 (RMB1,943m of 2,695m in FY2024; 702m of 1,672m in H1 2026) and RMB1.5-1.8bn/yr of cash dividends to minorities. The profitable consolidated subsidiaries (Shanghai Mitsubishi Elevator and the like) carry heavy NCI while the parent's wholly-owned thermal and EPC operations run at a loss, so attributable profit ex-associates is negative. The flows are modelled CONSOLIDATED and the NCI stock is deducted ONCE in the equity bridge at book, RMB25,112m at 30 June 2026 (1.0x book, ~13x NCI profit, ~7.5% return on NCI book: book is a fair, not punitive, proxy). Calibration: modelled FY0 EBIT 2,561 x (1 - 50% cash tax) = ~RMB1.3bn NOPAT against consolidated net profit ex-associates of RMB1,317m, within non-operating noise (net interest -715, other investment income +700, disposal gains +506).
inputs.ebitda_definition: Adjusted EBITDA = operating profit 4,947 - investment income 2,469 (share of associates 1,769 plus 700 of dividends/FV income on financial assets, all excluded from the flows and matched by assets in the bridge) + financial expenses 830 (net interest and bank charges, a financing item) - gains on disposal of assets 506 (non-recurring) + total D&A 3,536 = RMB6,338m, 5.0% of FY2025 total revenue of 126,679. It is AFTER credit impairment losses (1,031) and asset impairment losses (1,389), which have run at RMB2-3bn+ every year since FY2021 and are treated as a recurring cost of a thin-margin EPC/thermal business, after other income (1,433, mostly government grants, recurring) and after fair-value losses on financial assets (268, left in as conservative friction). Same definition gives 4.6% for FY2024 and ~6.1% for H1 2026 (H1 2025: 6.8%; the second half carries the year-end impairment charges, so a full-year margin is 1-1.5pp below the interim run-rate).
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF on the component engine (Drivers route), with the owner-fcf-adaptations applied: CNY-built WACC, lease treatment B, NCI deducted once at book, matching-asset bridge for stripped associate and investment income, SBC-zero so house and street coincide (band_position null). Routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical: industrials'. Identity confirmed from the filings: Shanghai Electric Group (power-generation and industrial equipment; segments Energy Equipment RMB75.0bn, Industrial Equipment 38.1bn, Integration Services 20.6bn in FY2025), NOT Shanghai Pharmaceuticals (2607.HK). WHY THE VALUE SITS WHERE IT DOES: on the consolidated level the business converts a 5% EBITDA margin into roughly nil owner FCF before working capital (D&A 2.4% vs capex 3.8%, cash tax 50-60% of EBIT because loss-making subsidiaries get no deferred-tax credit), and lives on the EPC prepayment float (contract liabilities RMB72bn, 54% of revenue). The upside case is therefore a margin-and-tax normalisation story (impairments fading as legacy thermal exits, unrecognised losses of RMB23bn being absorbed) rather than a growth story, even though the order book (FY2025 orders RMB172.8bn, book-to-bill 1.36; H1 2026 revenue +16.6%) supports double-digit near-term revenue growth. WORKING CAPITAL: positive capture (growth generates cash) because operating liabilities (payables 75.5bn + notes payable 16.4bn + contract liabilities 72.2bn) far exceed receivables + inventory + contract assets; FY2025 inflow 3.5bn on a 10.5bn revenue increase, FY2024 10bn on 1.4bn (order-driven). Base 15% of the revenue change, bull 20%, bear -5% (float unwinds as thermal orders fade). HORIZON 10 years because margin and tax rate are still ramping at year 5. The price is an intraday print at the 52-week low; not an after-hours print, but should be replaced at the next regular close.
inputs.guidance_note: The company issues no quantitative revenue, margin or EPS guidance. Year-1 (FY2026) growth of 12% base is anchored on H1 2026 revenue +16.6% and H1 2026 new orders of RMB100.4bn (FY2025 full year 172.8bn, +12.5%), tapered for a thermal-heavy second half; FY2026 margin 5.3% is the FY2025 5.0% plus a third of the H1 2026 improvement, since year-end impairments recur.

bear.narrative: Bear: the coal-fired order wave peaks in FY2026 and state utility capex rolls over with the 15th Five-Year Plan; revenue stalls and then shrinks for two years as thermal deliveries fall faster than wind/nuclear/storage grow. Fixed-price contracts meet steel and copper inflation, impairments stay at 2.5-3% of revenue, and the EBITDA margin slips to the FY2024 level and below. Loss-making subsidiaries keep absorbing profit with no tax relief (cash tax stays above 50% of EBIT). The prepayment float unwinds as orders fall, so working capital turns from a source to a use of cash. Consolidated owner FCF is near zero or negative for most of the decade and the equity is worth little more than the associates, investments and net cash less minorities.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 12%: H1 2026 revenue +16.6%, orders RMB100.4bn in the half against 172.8bn for all of FY2025, tapered for a thermal-heavy second half. Fades 8/6/5/4 as the current coal-fired and wind order wave is delivered, to 2.5% terminal, below Chinese nominal GDP, as coal-fired equipment declines and nuclear/storage/overseas EPC only partly replace it.
base.margin_rationale: Adjusted EBITDA margin (after impairments, see inputs.ebitda_definition) 4.6% FY2024, 5.0% FY2025, ~6.1% H1 2026. Y1 5.3% keeps most of the H1 2026 improvement but assumes the usual second-half impairment charge. Rises 0.1-0.2pp/yr to 6.0% by Y7 as legacy thermal units are exited and impairments normalise toward ~1.5% of revenue; does not reach the segment gross-margin-implied potential because EPC and integration services dilute mix.
base.capex_rationale: Capex 3.96% of revenue FY2025 (5,012), 3.8% FY2024, 3.3% H1 2026; construction in progress is rising (6.5bn). Held at 3.8% in Y1 and glided to 3.3% as the nuclear/wind capacity build matures; D&A ex-ROU rises from 2.4% to 2.8% as it depreciates, so capex stays ~1.2x D&A at maturity.
base.tax_rationale: FY2025 income tax 1,936 on total profit 5,022 is 38.6% headline, but on the modelled EBIT basis (ex-associates, which are post-tax) it is ~50-60%: RMB2,145m of losses in loss-making subsidiaries received no deferred-tax credit (FY2024: 1,395m), while profitable subsidiaries enjoy 15% high-tech rates. Modelled as a cash rate on EBIT starting at 45% and gliding to 30% by Y8 as thermal exits shrink the unrecognised-loss pool (RMB23.4bn of unrecognised deductible losses at FY2025); it does not reach the 25% statutory rate in the base.
base.terminal_rationale: Gordon at 7.0%/2.0% implies ~20x terminal FCF; capped at 12x, the low end of the method's 12-15x band for cyclicals, because the H share has traded at a sub-book multiple for a decade. The cap binds.
base.narrative: Base: the order wave (coal-fired flexibility retrofits, offshore wind, nuclear islands, energy storage, Belt-and-Road EPC) converts into double-digit revenue growth for two years, then fades. Margins improve slowly as the legacy thermal drag and year-end impairments shrink; the cash tax rate falls as the unrecognised-loss pool is absorbed. Working capital remains a modest source of cash because customer prepayments grow with orders. Minorities keep their share of the elevator JV and other profitable subsidiaries; the parent's own value comes from the associates, net cash and a slowly improving consolidated margin.

bull.narrative: Bull: the H1 2026 run-rate (+16.6% revenue, 6%+ interim margin) holds for FY2026 and the nuclear, offshore wind and storage pipelines keep orders growing double-digit into 2028; overseas EPC (Saudi PV, Kazakhstan wind) adds a second leg. The thermal legacy is fully exited by 2028 so impairments fall to ~1% of revenue and the EBITDA margin reaches 7%; the loss-sub pool shrinks so cash tax converges on the 25% statutory rate by Y7. Prepayment float captures 20% of the revenue increase. Nothing is assumed for the fusion, humanoid-robot or gas-turbine export options.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: the consolidated wholly-owned operations lose money (attributable profit ex-associates is negative), net margin is ~1%, liabilities are 76% of assets, FY2021-22 produced RMB13.6bn of losses from exactly the thermal legacy that is still being exited, and capital allocation follows state priorities over minority returns. Bull cut from 35% to 20%: it needs margin normalisation, tax normalisation and sustained order growth all at once, and none is guided. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
